abstract.p: We present new lattice-based attribute-based encryption (ABE) and laconic function evaluation (LFE) schemes for circuits with sublinear ciphertext overhead. For depth d circuits over ℓ-bit inputs, we obtain-an ABE with ciphertext and secret key size O(1);-a LFE with ciphertext size ℓ + O(1) and digest size O(1);-an ABE with public key and ciphertext size O(ℓ 2/3) and secret key size O(1), where O(•) hides poly(d, λ) factors. The first two results achieve almost optimal ciphertext and secret key/digest sizes, up to the poly(d) dependencies. The security of our schemes relies on ℓ-succinct LWE, a falsifiable assumption which is implied by evasive LWE. At the core of our results is a new technique for compressing LWE samples s(Ax ⊗ G) as well as the matrix A.
